summary: This Form 6-K reports that PureTech Health plc's founded entity, Seaport Therapeutics, priced an upsized IPO of 14.16M shares at $18/share, raising ~$254.9M. PureTech will hold 16,685,013 shares post-closing. The IPO is a public offering by Seaport, not a special situation for PureTech. It is a routine disclosure of a subsidiary's capital markets event. No special-situation characteristics such as acquisitions, divestitures, activism, or restructuring are present. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report of a press release.
